content_en: From seafood industry to AI platform seven figure ARR. He made seven figure revenue in seafood industry. Then left built Supademo. Another seven figure ARR. Joseph is serial entrepreneur. Started building projects and businesses at age fifteen. Now founder CEO Supademo AI native demo automation platform. Helps thousands companies create engaging interactive product demos for onboarding sales marketing or training. Now mid seven figure annual revenue three times growth this year eight times growth twenty twenty four. Supademo came from personal frustration. In traditional outdated industry food distribution as founder always struggled explain products features to technologically primary audience. Marketing language ineffective tried slides videos found creating editing maintaining extremely resource intensive. Potential clients rarely watch two plus minute video monologues. And hard keep these videos up to date with product and design changes. There must be a better way. After leaving last startup he started ideating and exploring met cofounder Koushik. Together they built Supademo rest is history. How built. Started from simple screenshot based product very narrow ICP and entry point. From there started.
content_jp: 海鲜業界からAIプラットフォームへ7桁ARR.彼は海鲜業界で7桁の収益达到了.然后离开建了Supademo.又一个7桁ARR.Josephは連続起業家.15歳でプロジェクトとビジネスの構築を開始した.现在是Supademo創業者兼CEO AIネイティブデモ自動化プラットフォーム.数千社がオンボーディング Sales Marketing トレーニング用の魅力的でインタラクティブな製品デモを作成助ける.现在年收入中7桁今年3倍成長2024年8倍成長.Supademoは個人的なフラストレーションから生まれた.従来の古い産業である食品流通でFounderとして常に技術的に初級の受众に製品の機能を説明することに苦戦した.マーケティング言葉は効果がなかったSlidesとVideoを試みたが作成編集維持は非常にリソース Intensiveだった.潜在クライアントは2分以上のVideoモノローグを見ることは滅多にない.そしてこれらのVideoを製品やデザインの変更に合わせて最新のものに保つことは難しい.必ずより良い方法がある.最後のスタートアップLeave後彼は思考錯誤を開始し共同創業者Koushikに出会った.共にSupademoを構築残りは歴史だ.怎么 построили?简单截图产品开始从非常狭窄的ICP和切入点开始从那里开始...
